responsePromise: We come back to every enquiry within a day.

process.detail: A few details and a photo or two is enough to get started. No forms to print, no site visit needed yet.
We measure up, check access and talk through what you actually want, then put a fixed price in writing.
You pick a start date. We turn up when we said we would and leave the place tidy.

faq.q: How long is a bathroom out of use?
faq.a: A full renovation is usually a few weeks. We give you a real date and tell you as soon as anything moves.

faq.q: What is waterproofing and why does it matter?
faq.a: It is the membrane under the tiles. Done badly it is the single most expensive thing to fix later, so it is certified and documented on every job.
We can, or you can. Either way we write down exactly what is included before we start.

faq.q: What happens if you find something behind the wall?
faq.a: Old pipework and rot do turn up. We stop, show you, price it and get your approval before continuing.
